headline: Gulf Coast residents upset by BP settlement funds
snippet: Gulf Coast officials expected money for coastal recovery; lawmakers used it for Medicaid and debt.

headline: BP Settlement Bill Passes Legislature, Signed By Governor
snippet: Created AL Economic Settlement Authority, ~$640M bond issue backed by BP settlement to repay debts and fund Medicaid.

headline: House Passes BP Oil Settlement Raid to Prop Up Medicaid
snippet: Critics called it a 'raid' on funds intended for Gulf Coast restoration to patch Medicaid shortfalls.
